ARC-001-REQ-v1.0.title: Project Requirements: NHS Doctors Online Appointment System

controlFields.Distribution: Project Team, NHS Digital, GDS Assessment Team, Clinical Safety Officer
Steering Committee, NHS Digital Director, NHS England Director, Clinical Safety Officer, Security Lead, IG Lead, Product Owner
Steering Committee, NHS Digital Director, NHS England Director, Clinical Safety Officer, Security Lead, IG Lead, Product Owner
Product Owner, Delivery Manager, GDS Assessment Team, NHS Digital Director, Enterprise Architect
controlFields.No user research sessions conducted: CRITICAL - GDS assessors require evidence of research with real users, not documented assumptions
controlFields.Personas appear assumption-based: HIGH - Personas should be derived from research, not created as archetypes
controlFields.No user journey maps: HIGH - Assessors expect visual journeys showing pain points and opportunities
controlFields.No evidence of research with diverse dem: MEDIUM - GDS expects research across age, ability, digital literacy, ethnicity
controlFields.No service landscape map: HIGH - Assessors need to see how this fits with NHS App, 111, practice websites
controlFields.No channel shift strategy: MEDIUM - Need to show planned migration from phone to digital
controlFields.No cross-channel journey maps: MEDIUM - Show how users move between online and phone
controlFields.No prototype or working software: CRITICAL - Cannot demonstrate simplicity without something to show
controlFields.No usability testing results: CRITICAL - Assessors need evidence that real users find it simple
controlFields.No content design work: HIGH - Plain English content not yet written
controlFields.No design mockups or wireframes: HIGH - Visual evidence of design approach needed
controlFields.No accessibility audit results: MEDIUM - Planning is strong but no test results yet (acceptable at Alpha)
controlFields.No testing with assistive technology use: MEDIUM - Plan exists but not yet executed (acceptable at Alpha)
controlFields.No team roster or org chart: HIGH - Assessors want to see named team members with roles
controlFields.No evidence of user research capability: HIGH - User researcher mentioned but no evidence of activity
controlFields.No content designer identified: MEDIUM - Content design is critical for NHS services
controlFields.No evidence of agile practices in use: HIGH - Stating agile is different from demonstrating it
controlFields.No backlog or user stories: HIGH - No prioritised backlog artifact exists
controlFields.No sprint review/retrospective outputs: HIGH - Key agile ceremony evidence needed
controlFields.No prototype or working software to iter: CRITICAL - Cannot demonstrate iteration without a product
controlFields.No evidence of design changes based on r: CRITICAL - Core of Point 8 is showing learning-driven change
controlFields.No A/B testing or design comparison: MEDIUM - Assessors like to see alternative approaches explored
controlFields.Document iterations are governance, not: MEDIUM - STKE versions changed format, not based on user feedback
controlFields.Penetration testing not completed: MEDIUM at Alpha (CRITICAL for Beta/Live) - Noted as gap but acceptable at Alpha stage
controlFields.4 mandatory GDS KPIs not explicitly mapp: HIGH - GDS requires cost per transaction, user satisfaction, completion rate, digital take-up
controlFields.No analytics implementation plan: MEDIUM - How will metrics be collected?
controlFields.No High-Level Design (HLD): CRITICAL - No architecture documentation showing technology stack, components, or patterns
controlFields.No architecture diagrams: CRITICAL - No C4, deployment, or integration diagrams
controlFields.No Architecture Decision Records (ADRs): HIGH - No documented rationale for technology choices
controlFields.Programming language/framework not state: HIGH - No mention of application language (Node.js? Python?)
controlFields.No open source strategy: HIGH - Need to articulate what will be open, what won't, and why
controlFields.No repository or code available: MEDIUM - Acceptable at Alpha, but plan needed
controlFields.No TCOP assessment: MEDIUM - Technology Code of Practice assessment not conducted
controlFields.Licence not chosen: MEDIUM - Need to select appropriate open source licence
controlFields.No contribution plan: LOW - Assessors like to see contribution back to NHS/GOV.UK patterns
controlFields.No operational runbooks: CRITICAL - No documented procedures for operating the service
controlFields.No load testing results: HIGH - Capacity planned but not validated
controlFields.No SLOs/SLIs defined: MEDIUM - Requirements reference SLOs but none formally defined
controlFields.GDS: Government Digital Service - sets the Service Standard for UK government services
controlFields.RAG: Red, Amber, Green - traffic light rating system
controlFields.Service Standard: 14-point assessment framework for UK government digital services
controlFields.Alpha: GDS phase where you prototype and test potential solutions
controlFields.Beta: GDS phase where you build a working service and test it in public
controlFields.Live: GDS phase where the service is fully operational
controlFields.FHIR: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources - healthcare data exchange standard
controlFields.GP Connect: NHS Digital API standard for GP system integration
controlFields.NCSC CAF: National Cyber Security Centre Cyber Assessment Framework
controlFields.SNOMED CT: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms
controlFields.C4: Context, Container, Component, Code - architecture diagram model
controlFields.SLO/SLI: Service Level Objective / Service Level Indicator
